changes: Quiet week for new frontier launches and new benchmark numbers: the main movements are Google routing Gemini 4 Argon (including a guardrails-off build) to defenders via the Fairwind program, UK AISI resuming most high-risk cyber evaluations after NCSC-supported hardening, NIST's CAISI renaming itself CAISSI, and Anthropic's red-team claim that a popular Chinese open-weight model reaches Mythos-class hacking ability. No scores are proposed for the dashboard this cycle.
incident: UK AISI resumes most high-risk cyber evaluations after NCSC-supported hardening
incident: NIST's CAISI renamed CAISSI (Center for Advancing Innovation and Standards for Super Intelligence)
incident: Google gates Gemini 4 Argon behind "Fairwind" defender program, including a build without cyber guardrails
